txt: title_text: Slow Drainage
description_text: Water that drains slowly from a sink, shower, bath or outside gully can point to grease, soap build-up, sand, roots or a narrowing in the line.
title: Service Icon Box - Slow Drainage

txt: title_text: Bad Smells
description_text: Sewer smells around bathrooms, kitchens or outdoor drains often mean waste is sitting in the pipe instead of moving away properly.
title: Service Icon Box - Bad Smells

txt: title_text: Gurgling Pipes
description_text: Gurgling after flushing or draining can show that air is struggling to move through the system because the line is partly blocked.
title: Service Icon Box - Gurgling Pipes

txt: title_text: Repeat Blockages
description_text: A drain that clears and blocks again needs more than another quick attempt. The cause may sit deeper in the line.
